parallels.note: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

translations.web: Then they will deliver you up to oppression, and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.
translations.bsb: Then they will deliver you over to be persecuted and killed, and you will be hated by all nations because of My name.
translations.kjv: Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake.
translations.asv: Then shall they deliver you up unto tribulation, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all the nations for my name's sake.
